versions.subject: Update win_alert_lsass_access.yml
versions.detection:
selection:
    EventID: 1121
    Path|endswith: '\lsass.exe'
filter_thor:
    ProcessName|startswith: 'C:\Windows\Temp\asgard2-agent\'
    ProcessName|endswith:
        - '\thor64.exe'
        - '\thor.exe'
filter_chromium:
    ProcessName|startswith:
        - 'C:\Program Files (x86)\Google\Temp\'
        - 'C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft\'
    ProcessName|endswith:
        - '\GoogleUpdate.exe'
        - '\MicrosoftEdgeUpdate.exe'
filter_vmware:
    ProcessName: 'C:\Program Files\VMware\VMware Tools\vmtoolsd.exe'
condition: selection and not 1 of filter_*
versions.spl: EventID=1121 Path="*\\lsass.exe" NOT ((ProcessName="C:\\Windows\\Temp\\asgard2-agent\\*" ProcessName IN ("*\\thor64.exe", "*\\thor.exe")) OR (ProcessName IN ("C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Google\\Temp\\*", "C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Microsoft\\*") ProcessName IN ("*\\GoogleUpdate.exe", "*\\MicrosoftEdgeUpdate.exe")) OR ProcessName="C:\\Program Files\\VMware\\VMware Tools\\vmtoolsd.exe")
